coverage.golden: published MSB-first CRC-16 (CRC RevEng catalogue, ITU-T V.41 family); binascii.crc_hqx cross-check (poly 0x1021, any init) + 5 catalogue check anchors on-chip
coverage.mutation: wrong poly (on-chip) / wrong init (on-chip) / reflected bit order / dropped byte / +1 shift step / +1 word shift / empty
coverage.edge: high input bits ignored; identical frames re-arm to init
coverage.decision: one 16-bit CRC word per frame_len bytes (rate-reducing)
coverage.note: 1-cell bit-serial carry-select datapath; EXACT, delay 0, tol 0
